49.original: (-Grizzled Passenger-)You were moanin' in your sleep an' sweatin' buckets besides. Rollin' of the ship got your stomach churnin', has it?

50.original: (-Grizzled Passenger-)Hmmm... Don't seem like seasickness, now that I look at you. It'll be the aether, then, I reckon.

51.original: (-Grizzled Passenger-)Some are more sensitive to the stuff than others, see, an' we ain't too far from Vylbrand now, which is chock-full of aetherytes.

52.original: (-Grizzled Passenger-)No need to fret, though. You'll soon get used to it.

53.original: (-Grizzled Passenger-)Eurgh. Might as well have been bloomin' seasickness... Ship's leapin' around like a demented chocobo today.

54.original: (-Grizzled Passenger-)I reckon I might head out on deck─get meself a breath of fresh air.

55.original: (-Grizzled Passenger-)Limsa Lominsa's still a fair way off, in case you were wonderin'. Seein' as you're awake an' all, how's about you keep me company till we get there?

56.original: (-Grizzled Passenger-)Them young'uns don't much care for conversation, see.

57.original: Anyroad, Brennan's the name, an' peddlin's me trade.

58.original: Ah, smell that salty sea breeze!

59.original: Now then, <hex:02080EE905FF056C617373FF046C616403>, judgin' by your unusual garments, I'd say you were one of them new adventurers. Am I warm?

60.original: I knew it! Goin' wherever the wind blows, seekin' fortune an' glory─now <hex:021A020203>that's<hex:021A020103> what I call livin'!

61.original: So long as you can avoid dyin', I mean. Ain't no secret that adventurin's a risky business─these days especially.

62.original: What was it that first attracted you to it?

63.original: Why did you become an adventurer?

68.original: ...<hex:021A020203>Power<hex:021A020103>? As in, er...power to do good? Like protectin' the weak, an' fightin' for what's right, an' all that? Aye, I thought that's what you meant. Well, adventurers do get up to a lot of fightin', that's for sure. You'll never be short of a chance to polish your warcraft in the adventurin' business.

69.original: Once we make port, you'd best sign yourself up at the Adventurers' Guild─they'll set you on the right path.

70.original: An' it wouldn't hurt to join a guild, neither.

71.original: Limsa's home to a few, so if you fancy learnin' how to swing an axe, or even sling a spell, you should think about seekin' one out.

72.original: Glory, eh? Well, if you're willin' to take on them tasks as other folk ain't, an adventurer such as yourself can win fame what coin can't buy.

73.original: When you arrive in town, you'll want to report to the Adventurers' Guild.

74.original: You can find out everythin' you need to know about the adventurin' business in there.

75.original: Fortune, eh? Well, it's a dream we've all had at one time or another.

76.original: Once you've learned to handle yourself in a fight, you'll want to pay a visit to whichever craftin' or gatherin' guild tickles your fancy.

77.original: Limsa Lominsa's renowned for its smitties an' armorers, not to mention its fisherfolk. An' then there's its cooks, of course.

78.original: Adventurin' ain't just about killin' things, after all. A peaceful pastime may well help you make your fortune!

79.original: Well, if you ain't inclined to tell, I ain't about to pry. Might be as ol' Brennan's a chatterbox, but he sure as hells ain't no busybody.

80.original: We all have a secret or three, don't we? Me? <hex:021A020203>Dozens<hex:021A020103>.

81.original: An' I'd rather they stayed secret, too─which is why I don't go stickin' me nose where it ain't welcome.

82.original: Just remember, though: there're more important things than fortune an' glory. Such as <hex:021A020203>breathin'<hex:021A020103>. Ain't no profit in bein' dead, an' that's a fact.

84.original: Ships off the starboard bow! Pirate colors!

86.original: Have ye no sense!? Get below!

87.original: What is the world comin' to...? Pirates firin' on a ship flyin' Lominsan colors! Bastards either have a boatload of balls, or bugger all for brains.

88.original: Ye can rest easy, friends! We've made it out o' cannon range, an' no buccaneer's bark'll catch this flighty temptress once the wind's in her sails.

89.original: That was too bleedin' close... Glad one of us kept <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> head on <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> shoulders─I reckon I'd've lost mine, otherwise.

90.original: If them pirates gave up the chase, we must be close to port. Let's head up on deck an' have us a look, shall we?

91.original: By the by, is this your first trip to Limsa Lominsa?

92.original: Is this your first trip to Limsa Lominsa?

95.original: It is!? Well then, let this journeyed itinerant tell you the ins an' outs of your destination. Ahem!

96.original: Thought not! Ah, but I'll wager there've been some changes since your last visit. Allow a journeyed itinerant to apprise you of the current state of affairs. Ahem!

97.original: Limsa Lominsa prides itself on bein' Eorzea's foremost naval power.

98.original: Weren't too long ago that the place was ruled by pirates, but thanks to the current Admiral's civilizin' influence, the city<hex:021F0103>state could almost pass for a respectable nation. You'd never guess she was once a rum-swillin' buccaneer herself! Heh heh!

99.original: 'Course, most folk ain't so quick to change, an' with a town full of liberty-lovin' ruffians, you can imagine how many naysayers an' troublemakers she's got to deal with─like them pirates who took a fancy to us just now.

100.original: An' if that weren't bad enough, I've heard the Sahagin are raidin' the coast just as bold as you please. Them're the sea-dwellin' beastmen the locals call “fishbacks,” 'case you didn't know.

101.original: Ah, at long last. Land ho!

102.original: Behold Limsa Lominsa, a nation blessed by the ocean's bounty an' beloved of Llymlaen, goddess of navigation.

103.original: On a windswept isle in the southwestern corner of the realm,

104.original: amidst the roiling waves of the Rhotano Sea, lies the maritime city<hex:021F0103>state of Limsa Lominsa.

105.original: To this haven for bandits and brigands, cutthroats and curs,<hex:02100103>seekers of both freedom and fortune, comes a lone adventurer.

106.original: Lone, yet not alone, for the hero's arrival has drawn the gaze of the nation's patron deity Llymlaen.

107.original: What realm-shaking fate has She descried in the churning waters of this mortal's future?

108.original: An' here's where we part ways, <hex:02080EE905FF056C617373FF04736F6E03>.

109.original: I'm off to the markets to deliver me wares, then it's on to the highroad for me.

110.original: Here, I want you to have this─by way of thanks for savin' me arse earlier.

111.original: Hey─you never did tell me your name, did you? Well, here's an idea...

112.original: Become the sort of storied personage I can brag about havin' met, an' I'll consider us square.

113.original: Through peril and hardship, discovery and triumph, may the Navigator guide this brave soul on <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> life's voyage...

116.original: (-Yellowjacket Infantryman-)Aye, I mean you. This is my district, and I make it my business to know all the scum that washes up in it.

117.original: (-Yellowjacket Infantryman-)Ah, an adventurer fresh off the boat, is it? Well then...

118.original: Allow one of Limsa Lominsa's finest to set you on the right path. Hop to it, <hex:02080EE905FF056C617373FF046C616403>, I haven't got all day!
